item.title: How to use AI to give yourself a head start at a new job
item.description: A new job comes with a steep learning curve. Used thoughtfully, AI can help you achieve mastery faster. When you start a new job there is a lot to learn. There are projects, clients, and processes that are likely to be new to you. You may have been pointed at the employee handbook and maybe even given a mentor. But you probably still have more questions than answers for the first few months. As trite as the phrase “drinking from a firehose” may have become, it is a pretty accurate description of those first eight or 10 weeks....
